تختلقين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِقِينَ (taḵtaliqīna) /tax.ta.li.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# تُخْتَلَقِينَ (tuḵtalaqīna) /tux.ta.la.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
